title: Contact & support
intro: Report a problem, ask a question, share feedback or request a feature. The AIS Alumni Committee will reply by email. You can use this even if you can't sign in.

COMPLAINT.label: Complaint
COMPLAINT.hint: Only the committee members handling it will see this.

FEATURE.label: Feature request
FEATURE.hint: Ideas for new features or improvements.

form.subject: Subject
form.subjectPlaceholder: e.g. I can't sign in with LINE

messageHint.default: Please be as specific as you can.
messageHint.ISSUE: When, on which screen, what you did and what happened (and your device/browser if you know).
messageHint.QUESTION: What would you like to know?
messageHint.COMPLAINT: Include when and where (which chat or post) if you can.
messageHint.FEATURE: When would it help, and what should it let you do?

form.name: Your name
form.emailHint: We'll send our reply and a copy of your request here.
form.privacy: The AIS Alumni Committee uses what you send only to handle your request.

errors.name: Enter your name (up to 100 characters).
errors.subject: Enter a subject (up to 120 characters).
errors.rateLimited: You've sent several requests just now. Please try again a little later.

sent.title: Sent
sent.body: We've received your request and emailed you a copy. The committee will reply as soon as they can.

admin.subject: [AIS Alumni] Support #{ref}: {type} “{subject}”
admin.intro: A new support request has arrived.
admin.reply: Reply to this email to answer the sender directly. When it's handled, mark it done in the admin page.

copy.subject: [AIS Alumni] We received your request (#{ref})
copy.intro: We've received your request below. The AIS Alumni Committee will reply as soon as they can.

admin.title: Support requests
admin.intro: Requests from members and visitors. Reply by email, then mark them done.

dialog.open: Ask a question or report an error
dialog.title: Questions & errors
dialog.intro: Stuck, or seeing an error while signing up? Send it here — the committee also gets which screen you were on.
dialog.help: Have a question or seeing an error?
